# Roof rack cross bar clamps

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Install Alpha Series UB2PA U-bolt pipe clamps sized for strut channel tubing diameter. [t271]

## Parts

- Alpha Series UB2PA: U-Bolt Clamp, 2" Pipe Size [t271]
- Stainless U-bolts, McMaster #3176T16: Corrosion resistant alternative to zinc coated. [t271]

## Tips & gotchas

- Use a standard u-bolt dipped in Plastidip or rubberized coating if the exact size is unavailable. [t271]
- Try 2-1/4" muffler clamps as an alternative option. [t271]
- Cut plastic inserts into two pieces to conform better to round bars. [t271]

## Common mistakes

- [Partial] Buying stainless steel bolts without verifying thread compatibility for trimming later. [t271]
